title: Withdraw a priority waitlist application (commercial)
summary: Learn how to withdraw a priority waiting list application for a commercial mooring by visiting a Service NSW Centre or posting a request.
intro: If you'd like to withdraw your priority waiting list application for a commercial mooring, you can do this in person at a Service NSW Centre, or post your request.
what_you_need: A written request to withdraw the application on the organisation's letterhead
Written authorisation of the nominated representative on the organisation's letterhead

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre and submit the application in person, or post your request and documentation to:Maritime Product ServicesLocked Bag 5100Camperdown NSW 1450.
